correctness.summary: Run indexes the parent array with the loop variable i (an order-position) but parent is keyed by vertex id (filled as parent[order[i]]=order[i-1] in ComputeOrder), so parent lookups use the wrong key whenever the BFS order is not the identity permutation, dropping/mis-routing dp contributions and returning a wrong total.
correctness.triggeringInput: A graph whose BFS-from-0 order is non-identity, e.g. n=3 with order={2,0,1} (vertices relabeled so BFS visits 2 then 0 then 1). ComputeOrder sets parent (by vertex): parent[0]=2, parent[1]=0, parent[2]=-1. In Run the loop reaches i=2 intending to process order[2]=vertex 1 (whose real parent is vertex 0), but it tests parent[2]=-1 and skips, so vertex 1's dp+edge contribution is never added to its parent. The returned dp[order[0]] is therefore too small / incorrect.
correctness.rootCause: Index-space mismatch: parent is indexed by vertex id, while Run treats the loop index i as an order position (it passes i as the order index to ComputeEdgeSum and reads dp[order[i]]). It accesses parent[i] instead of parent[order[i]], so for any permutation where order[i]!=i the parent edge is read from the wrong vertex.
correctness.suggestedFix: Replace parent[i] with parent[order[i]] in both the guard and the accumulation: `if (parent[order[i]] >= 0) dp[parent[order[i]]] += dp[order[i]] + wSum;`.

perf.summary: edgeW[order[i]*n + order[j]] is loaded twice per j (once in the != 0 test, once in the add), and order[i]*n is recomputed every iteration.
perf.currentCost: Per j: two pointer derefs into edgeW for the same cell, plus order[i]*n multiply, plus a branch. The branch is also pointless: adding 0 when the value is 0 yields the same sum.
perf.proposedChange: Hoist int oi = order[i]; long* row = edgeW + (long)oi * n; before the loop. Then `for (int j = i+1; j < n; j++) sum += row[order[j]];` — drop the != 0 test entirely (adding zero is a no-op) and read each cell once.
perf.rationale: Halves edgeW loads, removes a multiply per iteration via row-base hoisting, and removes a branch since the conditional add is semantically identical to unconditional add of a possibly-zero value. Tighter loop, better for Burst auto-vectorization (pure load+add reduction).
perf.risk: Only safe if edgeW entries cannot be a sentinel where 'absent' is encoded as a nonzero value that must be skipped — but the current code sums exactly the nonzero entries and adding zero entries changes nothing, so the sum is identical. Watch long overflow is unchanged (same accumulation order).

perf.summary: dp[order[i]] is read after parent check; order[i] and parent[i] indexed without hoisting; the n-element zero init can be combined but is already minimal.
perf.currentCost: Per i: parent[i] load, branch, then order[i] load and dp[order[i]] load plus dp[parent[i]] read-modify-write. order[i] is recomputed implicitly.
perf.proposedChange: Hoist int p = parent[i]; int oi = order[i]; once per iteration: `if (p >= 0) dp[p] += dp[oi] + wSum;` where ComputeEdgeSum is also passed oi to avoid re-reading order[i] inside it (or inline the hoisted oi).
perf.rationale: Removes duplicate order[i] indexing shared between Run and ComputeEdgeSum and shortens the dependency on parent[i]. Minor constant-factor win in an O(n^2) routine dominated by ComputeEdgeSum.
perf.risk: None; pure reindexing of the same values, identical results and accumulation order.
